공통.시작: Create one still photograph. A cinematic film still from a luxury men's cologne commercial, 16:9 frame. The whole film lives in one deep cobalt-blue world: a dark studio, saturated cobalt light, cold blue-white highlights only on edges.
공통.태준_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean man in his early thirties. Keep his face exactly the same in every detail: deep-set dark brown eyes with a slightly shadowed gaze, thick straight dark eyebrows, an angular jaw and high cheekbones, a straight nose, medium warm-toned skin with short light stubble on the chin, jaw and upper lip. He looks like a real man, not a mannequin or an idol. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add moles, freckles, marks, earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, watches, tattoos, sunglasses, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.태준_머리: HAIR: jet-black hair of medium length, swept back from the forehead with a few loose strands falling over the brow, ending at the nape — well above the shoulders.
공통.태준_몸: BODY: 184 cm tall, lean athletic muscular build, bare-chested with no shirt, plain black trousers, no jewelry or accessories of any kind.
공통.배치: Image 5 is a LAYOUT FRAME, not a photo to copy: the solid black shape shows exactly where the man is and how big he is in the frame, and the blurred blue shows where the light and dark fall. Copy exactly its camera position, height, angle, framing and the size and position of the black shape, and match its light layout. The black shape is only a placement guide — never copy its hair outline (his hair is medium length as described above) and never paint the man as a flat black shape unless the shot says silhouette.
공통.표정: EXPRESSION: calm, natural neutral face, lips closed, no smile.
공통.빛: LIGHT: low exposure and soft contrast; strong cold backlight and rim light trace his outline (shoulders, arms, jaw); the front of his body stays in deep blue shadow; the darkest areas are deep navy, never pure black; one stop darker than a portrait photograph.
공통.마감: FINISH: a real photograph with natural skin texture and pores, not airbrushed, subtle film grain, no CGI look.
